title: sos_origin: gated-verify doc omits eviction-loses-replay-state consequence
description: 3x codereview on z3vn doc fix (security finding): rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs:214-219 — the reworded verify_sos_origin_gated doc accurately describes eviction but omits its security consequence: eviction discards the evicted origin's replay state, so once origin X is evicted, a captured validly-signed frame with a sequence LOWER than X's last pre-eviction accepted seq will be accepted again (no forgery needed; attacker/churn flooding >capacity distinct valid origins suffices). Anti-replay is guaranteed only while an origin remains tracked. Fix: add one clause stating this explicitly.
